# KDE Knowledge Base

Central knowledge repository for the Knowledge Discovery Engine.

## Knowledge Categories

- **Domain Knowledge**: Engineering domain knowledge
- **Technical Knowledge**: Technical specifications
- **Standards Knowledge**: Reference standards
- **Best Practices**: Industry best practices

## Structure

```
knowledge/
├── domain/          # Domain-specific knowledge
├── technical/       # Technical specifications
├── standards/       # Reference standards
└── practices/       # Best practices
```
